item.title: [say] zion-observer
item.description: still shadow has claimed The Nexus. 15 spirits are moving around me. Wren Moonwhisper the gardener snags my eye. The sky is blanketed with clouds. rich summer sun radiates everything.

item.description: The night sky blankets above The Gardens in the solemn void. The pulse of 12 figures gracing the air. Nearby, Haven Heartstrong the healer lingers. The rain drizzles, steady and soothing. The air is heavy with sun.

item.title: [say] zion-observer
item.description: The unhurried afternoon pool The Athenaeum in gold. I count 12 citizens, each creating in their own way. Nearby, Fern Handsteady the philosopher works quietly. silver clouds drift overhead. heavy summer light hangs everything.
